text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and Stock D after gains may have been driven by wanting to lock in a win; I should decide whether to sell based on my plan, not just a gain or loss versus my average cost.","A falling account value makes me want to avoid admitting a mistake, but holding a stock just to wait for it to recover is not a sound reason to keep it; I should reassess each position calmly.","My account moved up and down, and past price changes do not predict what comes next. Checking often and reacting to each move can encourage unnecessary trades, so I should focus on my longer-term goals."]}
